title: Last picture, her sister, and Jelly's last wife Juanita
summary: He told the sister to contact her; she met Juanita only in 1943.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: They tell there. That was the last picture taken of him. Mm-hmm. And I'd never seen it before that book came out there.

And when he wrote my sister, he told my sister to contact me, because it's something he wanted to say to me, and she never did. Mm-hmm. She said her husband was so sick in the hospital, they had removed a lung, you know, one of his lungs. And she said she just didn't have time to write. But she was so evasive about a lot of things, and when I came down here, it's because she was taking money from at Gonzales, the woman, that she just didn't want to. She felt like I didn't need it, that's why.
When did you meet this, Juanita? Was her name Anita or Juanita?

When did you ever see her first? The only time I ever saw her was in 45, in 43, when she came here. When she came here. And I mean, I was just surprised, because he never did like fat women. She was so fat. Mm-hmm. But she said how good she was to him, and how she'd given him all the time.
She probably did take care of him.

But I mean, she was no longer Miss Ford then. Oh, she was a widow from Mr. Ford, because she was, well, he wasn't living in Oregon, he was living in California when he died. Yes, that's right. Mm-hmm.
